ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited Q1 FY2026-27**  Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited's Q1 FY2026-27 unaudited consolidated results show a concerning 80% year-over-year and 87% quarter-over-quarter decline in Net Profit After Tax and EPS, settling at Rs. 1038.83 Lakhs and Rs. 1.55 respectively. Despite a modest 12% increase in total income from operations year-over-year, this severe compression in profitability highlights a significant material impact and a major red flag regarding operational efficiency or cost management.
